items.note: The prompt doesn't frame the decision as pgvector vs a dedicated vector DB.
It gives no data scale (5M x 1536-dim, +1M per quarter).
It doesn't say the team already runs Postgres 16 on RDS.
It doesn't require filtering by tenant_id for multi-tenant queries.
It sets no limit on how many options to compare (max 4).
It doesn't ask for a comparison table plus one recommendation.
It doesn't ask for sources from the last 12 months.
It doesn't describe the approach (wide scan, then deep on the top 2).
